# A strict run stops right after the first answer read as cannot_tell, even
# when that is the run's last call: Privacy violation, the last question, is
# asked only about CVE-2024-2222 (CVE-2024-1111's vector floors
# confidentiality), in the second batch. The first batch was already rated,
# yet neither the VEX nor the attestation is written.
env VENS_MOCK_LLM_CANNOT_TELL=one_individual
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=mock --llm-batch-size=1 --attest --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'strict: the answer to Privacy violation \(PV\) for CVE-2024-2222 reads as cannot_tell, counted as privacy_cannot_tell; stopping the run'
stderr 'Scored vulnerability.*CVE-2024-1111'
! stderr 'Scored vulnerability.*CVE-2024-2222'
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* llm_calls=17 .* calls.PV=1 .*counters.privacy_cannot_tell=1 .*failed=true'
! stderr 'calls.adjustment'
! exists out.cdx.json
! exists out.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls $VENS_TEMP_GLOB'

# The same answers without --strict take Privacy violation's worst case,
# counted, and write both files: the run makes the same 17 calls, so the
# strict run stopped at its last.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --llm-batch-size=1 --attest --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* llm_calls=17 .*counters.privacy_cannot_tell=1 .*failed=false'
exists out.cdx.json
exists out.attestation.cdx.json
json-contains out.cdx.json '"CVE-2024-2222"'

# A strict run stopped at its last call leaves the VEX and the attestation a
# previous run wrote byte for byte.
cp out.cdx.json prev.cdx.json
cp out.attestation.cdx.json prev.attestation.cdx.json
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=mock --llm-batch-size=1 --attest --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'strict: the answer to Privacy violation \(PV\) for CVE-2024-2222 reads as cannot_tell'
cmp out.cdx.json prev.cdx.json
cmp out.attestation.cdx.json prev.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls $VENS_TEMP_GLOB'

-- config.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "strict-late-abort"
  description: "A strict run whose last call answers cannot_tell"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
  listener: present
  data_subjects: thousands
  detection:
    network: logged
    host: not_logged
    application: logged_and_reviewed
  traceability: per_request
